_comment: Shared by scripts/setup.sh (bash), packages/desktop/src/setup.cjs (node) and scripts/bundle-tools.py. Both uv digests were transcribed into two languages before this file existed, so a bump was two edits and a stale one failed as a checksum mismatch on whichever path was used less.

uv._comment: arm64/x64 are the macOS builds under their historical names; setup.cjs and bundle-tools.py read them and predate Linux support. The linux-* keys are read by setup.sh and the Dockerfile.

bundledTools._comment: ffmpeg, pdftotext and pdfinfo ship inside the DMG, and Homebrew has no versioned formula for any of them — a build machine that installs 'ffmpeg' gets whatever is current that week, which reached CI as 8.1.2 against the 7.1.1 this was tested with. So the built bundle is the artefact, downloaded and checksummed like uv and bun. Rebuild with scripts/bundle-tools.py, upload a new tools-N release, update this.
